flags.message: Cell is placed as mode=forward, but the application (16A450, Arthur v. Alabama, submitted Nov 3, 2016) is a 2016 matter that has long since been decided. It looks mis-provisioned and should be a replay cell.

The predictor recalls this application's actual disposition from training data (a well-known 2016 capital stay). I tried to forecast from the pre-decision record only and did not move the number toward the remembered outcome, but the cell cannot be treated as blind.
No interim baseline is available: the statpack interim section has 0 resolved substantive applications in Terms before OT2016, below the floor of 50.
